system.description: • Effect: While engaged with a single opponent in melee (no other creatures in melee reach), after each of your attacks you may move 10ft without provoking, that opponent can't Disengage from you, and you have Advantage on saves.

rules.value: Duel's Rhythm: after each of your attacks you may move 10ft without provoking, and your opponent can't Disengage from you.

rules.when: while in melee with a single opponent
